subject: Hosted API data location, retention & deletion — Customer Q&A
messages:
From: Miguel Alvarez <miguel@cyclonehealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Cyclone Health Security <security@cyclonehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Q: Hosted API — data location, retention, deletion (security questionnaire)

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for taking this. Our security team sent over a short questionnaire (attached) focused on hosted API behavior for customer data: where it resides (region), how long different types of artifacts are retained (request logs, embeddings, cached KV, backups), and what the deletion process looks like when we request data removal (including backups and deletion proof). Cyclone handles PHI in some flows, so we need clear timelines and guarantees.

Key items they asked:
- Can we pin our traffic/resident copies to a single region (EU-US split)?
- How long are request payloads stored in logs vs metrics?
- What’s the TTL for any in-memory or on-disk KV/prefix caches and embeddings derived from our inputs?
- Upon a deletion request, what is the SLA to remove customer-identifiable inputs and any derived embeddings or cached context?
- Do backups/snapshots retain deleted data, and if so for how long?
- Can you provide evidence of deletion (audit log or signed statement)?

I attached the Cyclone questionnaire — can you and your Compliance folks fill this out and return (we're trying to close the review by EOD Tuesday).

Appreciate the quick turnaround,
Miguel

[Attachment: Cyclone_Security_Questionnaire.pdf (PDF)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Miguel Alvarez <miguel@cyclonehealth.com>
Cc: Cyclone Health Security <security@cyclonehealth.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q: Hosted API — data location, retention, deletion (security questionnaire)

Miguel —

Thanks for sending this over. I pulled together a concise set of answers below and attached a one-page retention summary (redwood_hosted-data-retention.pdf). Neha from Compliance is CC'd with additional detail.

High-level answers (hosted API):
- Region pinning: We support regional endpoint pinning. By default, tenant request processing is routed to the region closest to the caller, but we offer a region-pin option so all compute and short-term storage remains in the requested region (e.g., eu-west-1 or us-east-1).

- Request payloads & logs: Raw request payloads are persisted to transient request logs for troubleshooting and analytics. Default retention for raw request logs is 30 days. Aggregated metrics and usage counters are retained for 13 months.

- KV / prefix caches & embeddings: Runtime prefix/KV caches are ephemeral (in-memory and local SSD) and have configurable TTLs; default TTL is 1 hour for prefix caching and 7 days for embeddings stored to our cache tier. We do not persist embeddings to long-term storage unless customer explicitly enables a feature that stores embeddings (e.g., vector search integration).

- Deletion process and SLA: For hosted API, standard deletion request (via support console or API) triggers an automated pipeline:
  1) Mark the tenant's request and queue deletion tasks.
  2) Remove request payloads from active request logs and metric indices (within 24–48 hours).
  3) Evict entries from KV/prefix caches immediately on request; cached embeddings are scheduled for removal within 48 hours.
  4) For any persistent secondary stores (logs, indexes), we run sanitization/expunge jobs which complete within 30 days.

- Backups & snapshots: Backups are retained for 90 days by default. Deleted customer-identifiable data may persist in backups until those backup retention windows expire; however, we can accelerate deletion from backups for enterprise customers under specific contractual commitments (we'll need to negotiate).

- Evidence of deletion: We provide an audit record for deletion requests (timestamped job ids and affected data classes). For higher-assurance requirements we can provide signed deletion attestations and an export of the deletion job logs.

I attached a short PDF that summarizes the above with timelines. Let us know if you need the SOC2 report (I can share the access link) or help mapping these timelines to your internal PHI handling requirements.

Next steps: If Cyclone needs EU-only processing with guaranteed no cross-border replication, we recommend one of two paths: (1) enable regional pinning on hosted API + data residency add-on (48-hour deletion SLA and deletion attestations), or (2) move to Dedicated/Private deployment for strict contractual isolation. Happy to walk through both with your security and procurement teams.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Miguel Alvarez <miguel@cyclonehealth.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Cyclone Health Security <security@cyclonehealth.com>

Subject: Re: Q: Hosted API — data location, retention, deletion (security questionnaire)

Hi Miguel,

Adding some compliance-specific detail to Jonas' answers so your security team can map items to their checklist:

- Encryption: All customer traffic is TLS 1.3 in transit. Data at rest (including logs and backups) is encrypted using AES-256. For hosted customers we offer platform-managed keys by default; for customers requiring stronger key control we support customer-managed keys via KMS (bring-your-own-key).

- Embeddings & ephemeral material: Generated embeddings and temporary KV entries are considered "derived artifacts." Unless you've enabled persistent storage of embeddings or vector-store integrations, these are treated as ephemeral and subject to cache eviction policies. Default: prefix cache TTL = 1 hour; embeddings cache TTL = 7 days. We can shorten these TTLs on request and include that in the contract.

- Backups & snapshot retention: Standard snapshot retention is 90 days for the hosted control plane. Snapshots are immutable once created; deletion requests do not retroactively remove data from existing snapshots — they remain until their retention window expires. For customers with compliance needs we offer accelerated snapshot scrubbing as a contractual option (typically adds a 2–6 week turnaround depending on snapshot lifecycle).

- Legal holds & exceptions: If Cyclone issues a legal hold, deletion jobs are paused until the hold is released. We will surface this behavior in the deletion attestation.

- Auditability: We track deletion request lifecycle as an auditable event with job IDs, operator IDs (for manual escalations), and timestamps. For contracts that require it, we can provide deletion attestations signed by our security team and a CSV export of the deletion job events.

Please tell us which of the following you need in writing: (A) 48-hour deletion SLA for hosted API with deletion attestation (B) EU-only processing via regional pinning + attestation (C) expedited backup scrubbing for PHI (enterprise add-on). We will confirm scope and pricing once you indicate preference.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

From: Miguel Alvarez <miguel@cyclonehealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 08:26:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q: Hosted API — data location, retention, deletion (security questionnaire)

Thanks Jonas and Neha — that helps a lot. Couple follow-ups from the Cyclone security team:

1) We need formal confirmation that regional pinning will prevent cross-border replication for customer data (no async backups to other regions). Is that supported as a hard guarantee for hosted customers, or only on Dedicated/Private?

2) For PHI flows we want the embeddings TTL shortened to 24 hours and a deletion attestation after removal. Can you confirm you can (a) set embeddings TTL=24h for Cyclone and (b) provide a signed attestation with deletion job IDs?

3) For audit purposes we also need an export of the deletion job logs (CSV) after the deletion completes. Is that available via the Console or do we get it from Support?

We're leaning to keep using hosted API if we can get the 24h TTL + attestation + guarantee on regional residency; otherwise we'll evaluate Dedicated.

Best,
Miguel

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Miguel Alvarez <miguel@cyclonehealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q: Hosted API — data location, retention, deletion (security questionnaire)

Hi Miguel —

Appreciate the clear ask — happy to make this work. Summary of commitments we can offer for Cyclone on hosted API (subject to contract addendum):

1) Regional residency: We will enable EU-only or US-only regional pinning for your tenant. With regional pinning enabled, we guarantee no cross-region replication of your customer data for active processing. Note: regular immutable backups are still indexed to the region; cross-region disaster-recovery copies are disabled for pinned tenants. This will be reflected in the addendum.

2) Embeddings TTL: We can set the embeddings cache TTL to 24 hours for your tenant. We will also configure the deletion pipeline to prioritize eviction of any derived embeddings on request and surface the deletion job id.

3) Deletion attestations & logs: We will provide a signed deletion attestation (PDF) that includes job ids and timestamps. Deletion job logs (CSV) can be exported by Support after job completion; we will provide a copy via secure link and store the attestation in the tenant’s audit bundle in the Console.

4) Backups: Default backups remain 90-day retention. For PHI-sensitive customers we offer expedited backup scrubbing (enterprise add-on) — this shortens snapshot retention windows and provides prioritized deletion of deleted artifacts from backups where feasible. Timeline for scrubbing will vary with snapshot schedule; typical range is 2–6 weeks.

If you want the above in writing, I can loop in Legal and Procurement. Jonas, please prepare the contractual addendum offer (48-hour deletion SLA + regional pinning + 24h embeddings TTL + deletion attestations) and include pricing and timeline. Neha — please confirm the language we should use in the attestation. Miguel — if that package works, we can aim to sign the addendum this week so we can enable the tenant settings.

Thanks —
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Customer Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
